options.text: $f(x)$ is not differentiable at two points
$f(x)$ is not differentiable at one point

solution.text:
Here, $f(x)=\min .\left\{1, x^2, x^3\right\}$ which could be graphically shown as $$ \therefore \quad f(x)=\left\{\begin{array}{c} 1, x \geq 1 \\ x^3, x < 1 \end{array}\right. $$
$$ \Rightarrow f(x) \text { is continuous for } x \in R \text { and not differentiable at } x=1 \text { due to sharp edge. } $$
